Subject: SIG evidence kickoff and item list

Hi Vivek / Irene,

Thanks for taking the time today. BluePeak's InfoSec team has completed the initial SIG review and we have a prioritized evidence ask list for Redwood. The items we'd like by next Friday (2028-05-18):

- Key management runbook for rotation and revocation (procedural steps + owner)
- Network diagram showing VPC peering and subnets used for hosted inference
- Screenshots demonstrating access control for the console (login flow + RBAC role view)
- Retention policy and where logs are stored (S3/GCS path or retention duration)

Can you confirm who will own each, plus a Drive folder with access? We can provide a short in-person walkthrough after review if helpful.

Regards,
BluePeak Security
security@bluepeak.com
BluePeak Health

--
Note: please provide PDF/PNG artifacts and include an index file listing filenames and access scopes.

Thanks — quick clarification from my side after a first pass through the SIG specifics:

- For the console screenshots, BluePeak requested two distinct artifacts: (1) login flow + IdP SAML assertion header (redact user PII) and (2) RBAC roles page showing the custom role names and attached permissions.
- For network, we should include an anonymized overlay that labels subnets with purpose (inference, control plane, monitoring) and notes the egress firewall rules relevant to SOC scope.
- For KMS runbook, BluePeak wants: rotation cadence, emergency revocation steps, and an auditable checklist that a secondary oncall can follow.

Marcus / Marissa — can you add these specifics to the manifest doc in the Drive folder so the reviewers see the checklist against each file? I started the checklist at https://docs.google.com/document/d/KAySigManifest2028 and added a template for required screenshots.

Also tagging Marissa for Drive permission check — we gave the security@bluepeak.com account Viewer access but procurement asked for a shared link for the procurement team as well (they will need limited visibility to invoices only). Let's keep two top-level folders: Evidence (viewer) and Billing (restricted).

Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
